ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback! We apologize for your frustration with your Spirit II, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have.

If you have not recently done so, we would suggest starting with giving your burners a thorough cleaning. If the holes are clogged, that could lead to several issues, including this one. 

Please check out the following info for some tips on cleaning the burner tubes.

1. Make sure the grill is completely cooled before removing the grates. (For larger gas grills, be sure to remove your flavorizer bars as well) 

2. Use a clean Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush to gently brush the burner tubes in a side-to-side motion to remove any grease build-up and debris.

3. Avoid brushing lengthwise down the burner tube to prevent brushing grease back into the portholes. Try using a Weber Detailing Brush for best results. 

For more information about how to clean your burner tubes, see the link below.
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023605532-How-do-I-clean-my-burner-tubes-

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

Thank you for your feedback! We apologize for your concerns with your new Spirit, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have. We would like to help put your mind at ease.

Your grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. If your grill is not getting that hot, we would suggest starting by double-checking your current gas pressure. The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tube(s).

Here is a helpful link for review:
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/4977860598036-How-hot-should-my-gas-grill-get-

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
